correctness.rationale: Complete 2764-face enumeration for the 24-edge graph, 1358 disjoint matched unit incidences, and a global acyclicity sort across all 2763 nonempty simplices and 10488 Hasse incidences leave critical cells in dimensions 0,3,4 with counts 1,45,1. Exact integer Morse projection gives seven unit coefficients in the unique four-cell boundary; the primitive attaching map cancels one S3 and proves an integral wedge of 44 three-spheres. Independent original mod-two simplicial boundary ranks corroborate Betti 44. All 48 symmetry traces agree between direct signed Lefschetz sums and independent orbit-conflict polynomial recurrence; exact character orthogonality yields 15 nonnegative integral multiplicities with dimension 44 and invariants of dimensions 1 and 4. Code and output were executed from actual standalone paths.

originality.rationale: The closest fully inspected recent primary paper proves connectivity and selected homological vanishing for rectangular path products P3 square Pn, not the periodic 4-regular product C3 square C4. Its explicit 3-by-4 table yields rank nine on another graph. Published closely related computations concern rectangular matchings, perfect matching subcomplexes, or open-neighborhood complexes, none of which has a statement implying the present forty-four-sphere decomposition and order-forty-eight matching-homology character. Focused searches found no exact equivalent, which is not treated as a general uniqueness proof. Unpublished grid literature remains an acknowledged risk.

value.rationale: The 12-vertex product of a triangle and a square is the smallest Cartesian product of unequal cycle lengths, a natural first two-direction periodic analog of rectangular grid matching complexes. Its exact integral homotopy type and complete S3 x D4 rational homology module are mathematically meaningful graph-specific invariants that do not follow from rectangular graph classifications. The full 48-symmetry quotient retaining exactly one rational class, versus four for the cyclic-rotation quotient, adds a concrete application of the full character. No general-parameter theorem or equivariant wedge decomposition is asserted.
